notes.subject: נלך
notes.rationale: ‘bai yumi go’ i stap tupela taim, wankain olsem Hibru i stapim נלך tupela taim — kiah i kamap strong.

notes.subject: tok bilong Mose
notes.rationale: Mose i tokim Farao dairet, ol man i stap long kot bilong Farao.

translation: Na Mose i tok: Ol yangpela bilong yumi na ol lapun bilong yumi bai yumi go; ol pikinini man bilong yumi na ol pikinini meri bilong yumi, ol sipsip na meme bilong yumi na ol bulmakau bilong yumi bai yumi go, long wanem gat feistedei bilong Yahwe bilong yumi.
